prompt:
Create an exact 320x180 seamless repeatable pixel art outer-space starfield background for the Mars Crafts interplanetary travel sequence.

Use a deep near-black navy space background with a carefully balanced irregular distribution of tiny crisp white, pale blue and muted cyan pixel stars.

Most stars should be one or two pixels, with only a few slightly larger restrained star clusters to provide visual variety.

Keep the overall composition calm, dark and uncluttered so separate spacecraft, Earth and Mars planet sprites remain clearly readable.

Authentic 16-bit Game Boy Advance pixel art, limited color palette, exact square pixels.

Design the background to tile seamlessly horizontally and preferably vertically, without visible seams or abrupt edge changes.

Wide 16:9 composition.

No planets, no spacecraft, no large nebula, no galaxies dominating the scene, no text, no interface, no smooth gradients, no photorealism.
